items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I went in there with a big show from traveling on the road in the year of 1927. And the show was named the Miramak Miramakers.

ctx.x: Well, I went in there with a big show from traveling on the road in the year of 1927. And the show was named the Miramak Miramakers. And after I got in Chicago, well, I struck all, struck luck there with fellas like Al Wynn, Tiny Palm, and Hughie Swift and all them kind of fellas. And I just got good there and made good. So I just stuck on, got to blowing around there. Got up together with a little fella called Francois Louisanans. He had been trying to get a band up together. So we worked together, say about…
Well, to get back to the, you're getting there, you were playing with Miramaks, Miramakas? Miramakas. Now who was the Bronze Bannikens? That was the same album?
